scope: Targeted read-only traversal of the live-resolved OmniSurface wrapper imports; no recursive cache search or vendor changes.
coupling: OmniSurfaceBase line 613 supplies state::meters_per_scene_unit()*native_depth. OmniShared lines123-140 compute sigma_t=-log(T/(1+max(S)))/depth; a=compute_albedo(T*S); sigma_a=sigma_t*a^4; sigma_s=sigma_t-sigma_a. Scatter changes both extinction and the absorption/scattering split, rather than being a direct independent sigma_s slider.
coefficient_units: MDL length interpretation must also be checked against known physical-distance captures; no field turbidity units assigned.
